audit_comment: OA round five (capture pp. 17-22): the three nonhuman races - the korobokuru save ladders and ability modifications, the hengeyokai form doctrine with the Table 11 twelve-creature grid, and the three spirit folk powers with their life-force ties.

consts.name: dgeKoroClasses
consts.comment: Korobokuru prose (capture p. 17): four permitted classes - barbarian, bushi, samurai, wu jen

consts.name: dgeKoroSaveDivisor
consts.comment: Korobokuru prose (capture p. 17): the saving-throw bonus - +1 for every 4 1/2 points of Constitution vs. rods, staves, wands and spells, and the same vs. poison - the PHYSICAL COPY CONFIRMS the book itself prints 41h (a printed misprint for 4 1/2); read as the intended 4 1/2, the divisor pins as 2 (half the Con score per +1), the flag resolved

consts.name: dgeHengeClasses

consts.name: dgeHengeFormCount
consts.comment: Table 11 (capture p. 18): twelve traditional animal forms

consts.name: dgeHengeFormsPerDay
consts.comment: Hengeyokai prose (capture p. 19): form changes per day equal the character level - the 1st-level one-change example, the 3rd-level three

consts.name: dgeHengeAnimalHpHalved
consts.comment: Hengeyokai prose (capture p. 19): animal form carries one-half the hit points, rounded up - the 23-to-12 printed example; wounds carry over point-for-point; no change that would reach 0 or fewer; 0 hit points in any form is death

consts.name: dgeT11NoDamage
consts.comment: Table 11 (capture p. 18): the dash sentinel - no natural damage

consts.name: dgeT11NoMove
consts.comment: Table 11 (capture p. 18): the dash sentinel - no land, fly or swim movement

consts.name: dgeT11AlignGood
consts.comment: Table 11 (capture p. 18): the any-good alignment tier

consts.name: dgeT11AlignChaotic
consts.comment: Table 11 (capture p. 18): the any-chaotic alignment tier

consts.name: dgeT11AlignAny
consts.comment: Table 11 (capture p. 18): the any alignment tier (crab)

consts.name: dgeT11AlignEvil
consts.comment: Table 11 (capture p. 18): the any-evil alignment tier

consts.name: dgeSpiritClasses
consts.comment: Spirit Folk prose (capture p. 20): three permitted classes - samurai, kensai, bushi

consts.name: dgeBambooPlantPct
consts.comment: Bamboo spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): the chance to identify normal plants

consts.name: dgeBambooAnimalPct
consts.comment: Bamboo spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): the chance to identify normal animals

consts.name: dgeBambooHidePct
consts.comment: Bamboo spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): the chance to hide in shadows in woods or forest

consts.name: dgeRiverLowerWaterFeet
consts.comment: River spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): once per day lower a river or stream 10 feet for five rounds

consts.name: dgeRiverLowerWaterRounds
consts.comment: River spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): the lower-water duration in rounds

consts.name: dgeSeaWeatherPct
consts.comment: Sea spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): once per day predict the next 24 hours of weather at 75 percent (the OCR prints 7596)

consts.name: dgeSeaWeatherHours
consts.comment: Sea spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): the weather prediction window in hours

consts.name: dgeSeaFavorsPerYear
consts.comment: Sea spirit folk prose (capture p. 22): one favor from the sea per year - a specific request; two opposing requests cancel and both lose the favor

consts.name: dgeSeaGiftHonor
consts.comment: Sea spirit folk prose (capture p. 22): at honor 85 the Lord of the Sea bestows a gift - treasure, a service or a magic item (the pearl of rising tide named), no conditions

bools.name: dgeKoroBarbarianCommon
bools.comment: Korobokuru prose (capture p. 17): barbarians are the most common korobokuru class

bools.name: dgeKoroSamuraiSponsored
bools.comment: Korobokuru prose (capture p. 17): korobokuru samurai are rare - they must be sponsored by a human clan

bools.name: dgeKoroSavePoisonToo
bools.comment: Korobokuru prose (capture p. 17): the same +1 ladder applies against poison saves

bools.name: dgeKoroGoblinBonus
bools.comment: Korobokuru prose (capture p. 17): the +1 to hit bakemono, goblins, goblin rats and hobgoblins

bools.name: dgeKoroGiantPenalty
bools.comment: Korobokuru prose (capture p. 17): giants, oni, ogres, ogre magi and titans suffer -4 to hit korobokuru

bools.name: dgeKoroSizeLimits
bools.comment: Korobokuru prose (capture p. 17): cannot use the go-daichi, any polearm but the naginata, or any bow but the horsebow

bools.name: dgeKoroLanguages
bools.comment: Korobokuru prose (capture p. 18): speak the tribal, trade, spirit-folk and hengeyokai languages; no alignment languages and none learnable

bools.name: dgeKoroScoreBounds
bools.comment: Korobokuru prose (capture p. 18): the modified scores cannot exceed 19 nor fall below 8, 12 or 3 respectively - the pre-eligibility modifications

bools.name: dgeKoroFamilyRequired
bools.comment: Korobokuru prose (capture p. 18): player characters must belong to a family

bools.name: dgeHengeNotLycanthrope
bools.comment: Hengeyokai prose (capture p. 18): shapechange is natural - no moon cycles, no silver susceptibility, no wound transmission, no change-shape healing

bools.name: dgeHengeChangeRound
bools.comment: Hengeyokai prose (capture p. 19): changing form takes one complete round; armor and equipment do not change with the body

bools.name: dgeHengeScoresUnchanged
bools.comment: Hengeyokai prose (capture p. 19): level and ability scores are unchanged in all forms; the hengeyokai language is speakable in all forms

bools.name: dgeHengeAnimalReal
bools.comment: Hengeyokai prose (capture p. 19): the animal form is real, not illusory - undetectable by illusion-revealing spells

bools.name: dgeHengeAnimalInfravision
bools.comment: Hengeyokai prose (capture p. 19): infravision 120 feet and speak-with-normal-animals in animal form

bools.name: dgeHengeAnimalNoGear
bools.comment: Hengeyokai prose (capture p. 19): no weapons, armor, equipment or spells in animal form; only hengeyokai and animal speech

bools.name: dgeHengeBipedalFull
bools.comment: Hengeyokai prose (capture pp. 19-20): bipedal form - full hit points, all languages, infravision 120, all class gear; movement rate 12; no animal movement powers; easily identified

bools.name: dgeHengeHumanFull
bools.comment: Hengeyokai prose (capture p. 20): human form - full hit points, all class gear and spells, indistinguishable but for one retained animal feature; no infravision, no animal speech (understanding only), 12 movement

bools.name: dgeHengeNoClan
bools.comment: Hengeyokai prose (capture p. 20): hengeyokai belong to no clan - no kinship benefits or penalties; never establish families or strongholds

bools.name: dgeHengeProtector
bools.comment: Hengeyokai prose (capture p. 20): good-aligned hengeyokai may become protectors of a family or village at the family-establishing level - offerings of food, gifts and service in return

bools.name: dgeSpiritFamilyRequired
bools.comment: Spirit Folk prose (capture p. 20): all spirit folk must belong to a family or clan; they hold land and establish families when class and level allow

bools.name: dgeSpiritLordSummon
bools.comment: Spirit Folk prose (capture pp. 20-21): the spirit lord summons must be answered and obeyed - failure or dishonor brings natural disasters on the spirit folk and its human family; the spirit lord wins any conflict of interests

bools.name: dgeBambooTrail
bools.comment: Bamboo spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): alone on foot through woodland, forest or grassland - no trail; with others a -20 percent (-4 on 1d20) to track the group

bools.name: dgeBambooLanguagePerLevel
bools.comment: Bamboo spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): one forest-animal language learned per experience level, player-chosen

bools.name: dgeBambooSaveBonus
bools.comment: Bamboo spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): +1 saves vs. spells, rods, staves, wands and misc. magic of earth and wood

bools.name: dgeBambooGrove
bools.comment: Bamboo spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): the life force tied to a bamboo grove - grove damage suffers equal damage, grove destruction is instant death, entering the grove cures all wounds and diseases; the grove never moves, its shoots carry no power

bools.name: dgeRiverBreatheSwim
bools.comment: River spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): breathe in any fresh water, swim at normal rate, carried items stay perfectly dry

bools.name: dgeRiverSaveBonus
bools.comment: River spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): +1 saves vs. water-elemental magic; -1 vs. fire attacks

bools.name: dgeRiverLanguages
bools.comment: River spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): speak the fish language, the court language and the trade language

bools.name: dgeRiverLifeForce
bools.comment: River spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): the life force tied to one river in its natural banks - bathing cures all; drought weakens, flooding maddens, damming kills; drawn-off water is no longer the river

bools.name: dgeSeaBreatheSwim
bools.comment: Sea spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): breathe any salt water, swim at normal rate, gear never wets

bools.name: dgeSeaSaveBonus
bools.comment: Sea spirit folk prose (capture p. 21): +1 saves vs. fire-based attacks

bools.name: dgeSeaNoSeaTie
bools.comment: Sea spirit folk prose (capture p. 22): unaffected by changes in the sea and gain no healing from it

tables.name: dgeT11Grid
tables.comment: the Table 11 hengeyokai creatures grid (capture p. 18)
col_comments: the alignment tier column: good (carp, crane, dog, drake, hare, sparrow), chaotic (cat, monkey), any (crab), evil (fox, raccoon dog, rat) (capture p. 18).

the damage-die column: the natural-weapon die - 0 for the dash (carp, drake, hare, monkey, sparrow), 2 for the crane 1-2, 3 for the cat-crab-fox-rat 1-3, 6 for the dog and raccoon dog 1-6 (capture p. 18).
the animal-form AC column: sparrow 3, hare 5, rat 5, fox 6, monkey 6, carp 7, drake 7, crab 8, cat 9, crane 9, dog 9, raccoon dog 9 (capture p. 18).
the land movement column: crab and sparrow 3, crane and drake 6, cat-dog-monkey 12, raccoon dog and rat 9, fox 15, hare 18, carp 0 - the carp cannot cross land (capture p. 18).
the fly column: crane, drake and sparrow 12, 12 and 15; zero elsewhere (capture p. 18).
the swim column: carp 12, crab 6, drake 9; zero elsewhere (capture p. 18).
the ability plus column: the +1 or +2 of the modifications (capture p. 18).
the ability code column: ST 0, DE 1, CO 2, IN 3, WI 4, CH 5 - the plus-ability of the modifications (capture p. 18).
the ability minus column: the -1 or -2 of the modifications (capture p. 18).
the minus-ability code column: the minus-ability of the modifications (capture p. 18).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 11 grid: alignment tiers, damage dice, animal AC, the move/fly/swim rates and the ability modifications across the twelve forms (capture p. 18)

banner.title: THE ORIENTAL RACES, printed capture pp. 17-22 - the OA races round
banner.provenance: verified against capture pp. 17-22 of the oa.pdf OCR session (single Mistral-OCR capture; cites are capture pages). OCR NORMALIZATIONS: the capture prints infraction for infravision - the physical copy confirms the clean infravision (a pure OCR garble); the korobokuru save ladder - the physical copy CONFIRMS the book itself prints 41h, a printed misprint read as the intended 4 1/2, pinned as the divisor 2, the flag RESOLVED; the percent signs garble as 7596, 5094 and -2096 - read clean as 75, 50 and -20; the hare prints as here. BOOK QUIRK: the prose cites a badger hengeyokai though badger is not among the twelve Table 11 forms (the evil forms are fox, raccoon dog and rat) - pinned as printed, flagged. The Table 11 modifications pin as four columns: the plus, its ability code (ST 0, DE 1, CO 2, IN 3, WI 4, CH 5), the minus and its code.
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 27 closed, 208 open - the three races and Table 11 flip; the races run of Chapter 2 is done, the ten classes begin next (census 540 -> 541); NEXT - R619: the Oriental Barbarian and Bushi - the class doctrines, Tables 14, 15, 16 and 17, prefix dgf (verify free), audit "R619 OA barbarian bushi audit", include after rules/oaraces.h
